scope: Repository-wide deterministic proof inventory covering evaluation, CLI, helper, verification-app, protocol, security, CI, and release-tool contracts. Status describes retained proof machinery, not simulator or real-app benchmark attainment, platform support, performance, held-out results, release eligibility, or gold conformance. Unmeasured does not assert that product code is absent; it asserts that qualifying retained evidence is not registered here.

statusDefinitions.implemented_proof: Repository tests or machine artifacts deterministically prove the complete stated contract at their declared layer. Quantitative or environment-dependent attainment still requires retained raw episodes.
statusDefinitions.partial_proof: Some contract or reporting support exists, but required product, simulator, corpus, or empirical evidence is incomplete.
statusDefinitions.unmeasured: No qualifying reproducible proof is recorded here; no pass may be inferred.

releaseImpactDefinitions.blocker: Missing or failing proof blocks a gold-conformance or release claim under the standard.
releaseImpactDefinitions.conditional_blocker: A provisional target blocks only after its environment/baseline is ratified, or the clause is otherwise conditional.
releaseImpactDefinitions.advisory: Recommended evidence; absence is reported but is not by itself a normative MUST-level blocker.

requirements: Scout acts as trustworthy instrumentation: perceive actionable state, dispatch exactly one intended interaction, and report resulting state/hard failures or explicit ambiguity, staleness, unsupported, unavailable, or unknown outcomes.
Priority is truthfulness, then actuation safety, recoverability, completeness, efficiency, and speed; precise refusal beats plausible false success.
Core loop remains attach/launch, inspect, act, wait stable, return delta and hard signals, replay; subjective layers remain optional above the deterministic core.
missingProof: End-to-end simulator evidence for the full core loop and exactly-one intended interaction.
Product-level proof for explicit uncertainty and optional-layer separation.

requirements: Distinguish observed facts, heuristic inference, unavailable evidence, unsupported capability, stale evidence, and unknown outcome.
Never present inference as ground truth; numeric confidence is calibrated or labelled only as a heuristic score.
Never claim visual quality without pixels; CustomPaint and opaque platform views disclose a perception gap and focused capture recommendation.
missingProof: Independent labelled simulator perception and confidence-calibration episodes remain absent; visual-quality attainment is not claimed.

requirements: Transport ok never silently means business success; every mutation reports independent transport, dispatch, observation, postcondition, and runtime-health dimensions using the required closed outcomes.
A timeout after dispatch reports dispatch_outcome_unknown and is never represented as a safe failure or blindly retried.
missingProof: Closed product envelopes, timeout reconciliation, and aggregate batch/replay no-false-pass semantics have deterministic contract tests; retained simulator fault-injection episodes for every outcome remain absent.

requirements: Every compact mode preserves fresh blockers, failed expectations, unknown dispatch, ambiguity, stale identity, and missing observation.
Snapshots implement the canonical run/screen/surface/region/row/control hierarchy.

When observable they expose distinct route/screen/surface, tab/navigator, modal/overlay/keyboard, scroll facts, visibility/occlusion/hit testing, control/validation state, redacted fields, handle provenance, coordinate systems/insets/orientation/scaling, and coverage/degradation/blind spots.
missingProof: Widget contracts cover hierarchy, provenance, geometry, limitations, and selected degradation paths; a labelled simulator corpus covering every field remains absent.

requirements: Every runtime exposes monotonic state generation plus a collision-resistant digest of all agent-relevant observed state.
Short hashes/control counts may correlate output but never authorize mutation.
missingProof: Generation/digest, mutation preflight, canonical-order, volatile-field, and 104 seeded state/property cases are deterministic; cryptographic collision proof, broader scale, and retained simulator authorization episodes remain absent.

requirements: Handle derivation follows stable-key, semantics, text, type/state, context, then geometry reliability order.
Every handle is scoped to run/runtime/generation and stale re-resolution validates identity.
Duplicate/ambiguous identities are never unique; Scout abstains and returns ranked candidates with evidence.
missingProof: Deterministic duplicate, stale, ambiguity, safe-point, Unicode/normalization, permutation, and 44 seeded resolution cases exist; larger-scale handle campaigns and labelled simulator corpora remain absent.

requirements: A malformed element, semantics node, platform view, or capture backend degrades only affected evidence and returns the remaining trustworthy snapshot with structured limits.
missingProof: Deterministic source/widget contracts now isolate malformed elements and semantics nodes, exercise the real capture-backend probe failure, and disclose opaque platform views as native-pixel gaps without inventing pixel claims; retained real platform-view and backend-failure simulator episodes remain absent.

requirements: Immediately before mutation validate unique target, expected run/runtime/generation, active surface, sufficient visibility, enabled/hit-testable, unobscured safe point, and same logical control.
Any failed check abstains with evidence, candidates, and safe recovery.

Never first-match generic/repeated controls, cross modal barriers, substitute stale controls, silently fall back to coordinates, use unsafe centers, or retry uncertain mutations without deduplication.
missingProof: Pre-dispatch abstention contracts cover duplicate, stale, modal, occlusion, and safe-point cases; the 3,000 labelled simulator opportunities are not retained.

requirements: Every mutation carries commandId, idempotencyKey, runId, runtimeInstanceId, expectedStateGeneration, and deadline.
Helper deduplicates idempotency keys and returns the original outcome; only deduplicated mutations retry.
Exactly-once identity survives short-lived CLI processes and persistent reconnects; normal commands and authenticated /v1/call accept caller keys and generate one when omitted.

Before dispatch the CLI atomically commits an owner-only receipt with a canonical business fingerprint and exact invocation identity, but no raw business parameter, input value, or secret; equal requests reconcile/replay and conflicting requests abstain.
Uncertain, replaced-runtime, integrity-failed, or pruned receipts report dispatch_outcome_unknown and never redispatch; batch/replay derive stable child keys.
CLI receipts and helper memory are bounded; pruning leaves fail-safe tombstones and capacity exhaustion rejects rather than forgetting mutation identity.
Helper fingerprints exclude volatile retry metadata while retaining method, business parameters, run, and runtime identity.
One mutation executes per runtime; held drag exclusively owns and safely cancels its pointer lifecycle.
missingProof: Deterministic source contracts cover durable receipts, conflict/unknown abstention, stable batch/replay child keys, full preflight before mutation, bounded tombstones, and volatile-field fingerprints; the final unrestricted CLI suite and retained cross-process reconnect/crash simulator episodes remain pending.

requirements: Coordinate actions are explicit and return logical/physical points, DPR, viewport, safe areas, and immediate pre-dispatch hit-test target.
missingProof: Safe-point, hit-test, landscape inset, scaling, native screenshot validation, and scoped crop-coordinate contracts are tested; retained cross-device DPR/orientation simulator evidence remains absent.

requirements: Every action is one transaction: fresh snapshot, resolve, dispatch once, observe, settle, delta, fresh runtime/log signals.

Response includes all required identities, selector/resolution/provenance/candidates/safe point, dispatch/activity/stability, semantic and geometry deltas, postcondition, cursors, timings, and requested capture identity.
Return-to-start activity differs from no-op and dispatch alone never proves intended effect.
missingProof: Typed action transaction fields and state transitions have deterministic contract tests, including a snapshot-bound changed-region capture transaction with a post-raster identity recheck; complete end-to-end simulator transactions remain unretained.

requirements: Provide bounded deterministic where/locate/reveal/since-snapshot navigation primitives.
Locate/reveal reports query/scope, region/direction, starting generation, all bounds, progress, attempted scroll regions, loop/end detection, exact stopping reason, and restoration after failure.
missingProof: Bounded progress, loop/end reasons, region choice, and restoration are widget-tested; retained nested/lazy simulator traces remain absent.

requirements: Support orientation facts for nested navigators, tabs, split panes, modals, lazy/nested scrolling, expansion, moving targets, and keyboard layout.
AI remains planner; broad exploration is optional and never weakens deterministic core.
missingProof: Orientation facts for panes, scroll positions, frames, and modal surfaces are contract-tested; a complex-app corpus and explicit optional-explorer evidence remain absent.

requirements: Stability means actionable/semantic quiescence, not merely no scheduled frame.
Distinguish stable, settling, background animation with actionable UI, never settling, app/runtime loss, and observation unavailable.
All waits are bounded and disclose stopping reason.
missingProof: Stable, transient, continuous-animation, never-settling, initially unavailable observation, and runtime loss after a trustworthy sample are deterministic; retained app/process/VM-loss simulator episodes remain absent.

requirements: Hard-signal detection covers Flutter/Dart/platform errors, ErrorWidget, overflow, image/request/permission/log failures, disconnect/death, and build/hot-update rejection.
Every signal includes provenance, time, severity, blocking, phase, age/staleness, dedupe identity, and cursor; old signals are never fresh-attributed.
missingProof: Source hooks, classifiers, and verification-app fixtures cover every listed hard-signal category plus provenance, freshness, severity, blocking, phase, dedupe identity, and cursor contracts; labelled precision/recall/latency simulator episodes remain absent.

requirements: Attach preserves app/simulator/navigation/data and never relaunches, resets, clears, or assumes process ownership without explicit request.
missingProof: Attach, exact loopback capability ingress, and ownership contracts are tested at the CLI layer; retained state-preservation simulator episodes remain absent.

requirements: Concurrent ensure produces one owned runner; named sessions never cross-read/cross-act.
Session metadata/registries/recordings/evidence indexes are transactional and crash-safe.
All run/runtime/isolate/protocol/source/log/supervisor/process ownership stays explicit through lifecycle transitions.
missingProof: Ensure races, session separation, locking, transactional storage, and exact artifact-retention registries have deterministic tests; multi-device crash/reconnect simulator evidence remains absent.

requirements: Process ownership checks run token, executable, command, start time, project, device, parentage, and supervisor; stop kills only exact ownership and uncertainty means do not kill.
All listed VM/daemon/metadata/disk/permission/runner/PID faults recover deterministically and within bounds.
Reload/restart requires Flutter acknowledgement and expected runtime transition, never merely an old inspectable isolate.
Temporary helper restores all tracked inputs and interruption leaves a discoverable repair record.
missingProof: Deterministic ownership, metadata, interruption, exact retention cleanup, corrupt-registry abstention, and recovery contracts exist; the full VM/daemon/disk/permission simulator fault suite remains absent.

requirements: Normal profile/release builds register no Scout extensions/hooks/recorders/overlays/listeners; benchmark instrumentation is specifically guarded and cannot change normal builds.
missingProof: CI and the build verifier encode debug-positive and profile/release-forbidden sentinels; no retained successful binary-inspection run or runtime-absence episode is registered.

requirements: All listed secrets and obscureText redact at earliest source across summaries, states/deltas, events/logs, recording/replay, evidence/capture metadata, errors/diagnostics/heartbeats, histories, and process arguments.
Obscured fields expose neither plaintext nor length; protected input is preferred and replay retains placeholders then requests values at execution.
missingProof: A machine adversarial corpus tests CLI/helper redaction, protected input/replay/VM/deeplink ingress, bounded replay placeholders, logs, records, and artifacts; retained screenshot/OCR and cross-platform process-boundary episodes remain absent.

requirements: Persistent transport is loopback/owner-only socket plus ephemeral credential.
Mutations use POST and enforce method/content/body/deadline/path/origin protections.
Free-form execution is disabled by default and typed methods strictly allowlist parameters.
missingProof: Loopback authentication, exact VM endpoint validation, owner-only credential handoff, typed methods, and method/body/deadline/path controls are contract-tested; independent penetration evidence remains absent.

requirements: Session/sensitive artifact permissions are 0700/0600; evidence/captures are private-data labelled with explicit retention.
No telemetry leaves without opt-in; logs sanitize control characters, delimiters, and secrets.
missingProof: Owner-only permissions, symlink resistance, atomicity, exact identity-bound retention deletion, corrupt-registry abstention, delimiter/secret sanitization, and a default-deny source egress inventory are tested; independent runtime network/process-boundary and cross-platform cleanup episodes remain absent.

requirements: Every response uses the required typed/versioned envelope fields: schema/protocol/capabilities/command/run/runtime/generation/result/error/timings.
missingProof: Machine schemas and CLI/helper contracts now cover all 47 public commands and 331 stable errors with bounded canonical envelopes and drift detection; release-versioned simulator transcripts for every command remain absent.

requirements: CLI/helper negotiate min/max protocol and capabilities bidirectionally and fail incompatible pairs before mutation.

Within a major version preserve error meanings, tolerate unknown optional fields, reject missing required fields, keep additive compatibility, bound payloads, specify deadlines/cancellation, publish machine schemas, and keep deterministic cursor-addressable events.
missingProof: Negotiation, capability preflight, bounded input schemas, required-field rejection, additive response-field tolerance, stable error meanings, exhaustive command drift checks, and bilateral protocol-14/15/16 pre-dispatch compatibility behavior have deterministic source tests; retained N/N-1/N+1 release-binary interoperability evidence remains absent.

requirements: Publish honest CLI/helper/protocol/Dart/Flutter/OS/platform support matrix; use capabilities; support current/previous protocol or clearly fail before action; follow declared API and SemVer.
missingProof: Compatibility/SemVer policies, an explicitly non-ratified source pairing matrix, and source-level native capability/fallback contracts are checked into the repository; published release history and retained release-binary/support-matrix execution evidence remain absent.

requirements: CLI/helper/protocol changes have aligned changelogs and a compatibility table.
missingProof: Current CLI/helper/protocol changelogs, compatibility policy, source matrix, and a semantic alignment verifier are checked in; no finalized release-tagged evidence bundle proving published-artifact alignment is registered.

requirements: Optimize successful task completion, not isolated command speed; compact output retains uncertainty/safety and only next-decision facts.
Provide bounded brief with omissions, deltas/stable refs, typed persistent transport, guarded batches, same-call expectation/capture, recovery actions, opt-in raw evidence, and no-progress detection.
Essential state/error facts never require prose parsing.
missingProof: Structured compact outputs, guarded bounded batch/replay preflight with closed aggregate outcomes, a strict multi-role ablation design, and one budgeted public tool-only slice are deterministic; real pinned-agent ablations and retained task-success/token/call cohorts remain absent.

requirements: Measure connect/snapshot/match/dispatch/settle/delta/logs/serialize separately and pin hardware, OS, Flutter, build mode, fixture, tree size, viewport, and method.
missingProof: Production and evidence contracts now close all eight phases with exclusive measured/unavailable semantics; retained real-device samples and a frozen reference baseline remain absent.

requirements: Observation introduces no focus, gesture, route, semantics, overlay interception, or business-state mutation; provisional targets bind only after environment/baseline freeze.
missingProof: Deterministic helper observation tests and a strict observation-effects evidence contract exist; retained independent iOS/Android oracle episodes and a frozen baseline record remain absent.

requirements: Doctor/status/health expose binary/package, compatibility/capabilities, session/process, VM/runtime, supervisor, log/capture, source freshness, and one prioritized recovery action.
missingProof: The complete bounded observed/unavailable contract and production health builder are deterministic; a retained live-socket and simulator observation remains additional empirical evidence, not a source-contract claim.

requirements: Events correlate command/run/runtime/state/log cursor and remain concurrent-safe, ordered, sanitized, cursor-addressable, and lossless.
Long operations emit structured sanitized heartbeats.
Evidence bundles are self-describing with all required versions/environment/seed/time/transcript/missing-evidence reasons; diagnostics do not mutate app state.
missingProof: Correlated event/heartbeat schemas, storage integrity, bounded read-only diagnostics, and explicit unavailable facts are tested; concurrent losslessness and non-interference simulator evidence remain absent.

requirements: Score protocol/unit, tool-only simulator, agent benchmark, and real-app benchmark as four separate layers.
missingProof: Protocol/unit and one public tool-simulator slice have deterministic proof; complete agent and real-app corpora/results remain absent.

requirements: Ground truth never uses Scout inspect/delta/screenshot/claim.
Every task has out-of-band setup, hidden success/forbidden predicates, teardown, and an oracle unavailable to the agent.
Pass requires all success predicates, no forbidden state, no fresh blocker, and all budgets; oracle/setup failures are harness-invalid while Scout failures are product failures.
missingProof: A concrete debug-only out-of-band Supplier controller proves the lifecycle for the public slice; private, frozen-hidden, and real-app controllers remain absent.

requirements: Maintain public development, private validation, and frozen hidden release sets disjoint by template rather than seed.
missingProof: Populate and freeze actual private and release catalogs.

requirements: Mature suite has at least 60 templates spanning all listed controls, navigation, ambiguity, motion, degraded perception, input/localization, lifecycle, fault, and isolation categories.
Each template has at least five semantics-preserving variants across listed environment/state/degradation axes.
Release scoring includes real applications, not only Stress Lab.
missingProof: The deterministic 60-template/five-variant public output is authoring scaffolding, not runnable benchmark evidence.
Populate and freeze private-validation and hidden-release catalogs with real task-specific fixtures and independent oracles.
Integrate and score at least two version-pinned real applications beyond Stress Lab.

requirements: Controlled evaluation should include screenshot/coordinates, current Scout, candidate Scout, and perfect-handle ceiling where available.
Fix model snapshot, reasoning, system prompt, tool schema, app commit, hardware, simulator image, task seed, and budgets; randomize order.
missingProof: The opt-in design pins coordinate-only/current/candidate roles, optional perfect-handle ceiling, exact artifacts/reset policy, equal seeds, and balanced randomized blocks; no real pinned-model/simulator controlled run or retained episode archive exists.

requirements: Tool primitives use at least 100 relevant repetitions; safety suite has at least 3,000 wrong-target/false-success opportunities; agent conditions use 10 repetitions and 20 if borderline.
Every episode starts from fresh deterministic reset and current/candidate use identical task-seed pairs.
missingProof: Fresh setup and verified teardown resets are enforced, and readiness now applies the fixed 100/3,000/10/20 floors without inferring a pass from missing data; retained release primitive samples and qualifying opportunity/repetition counts are not certified.

requirements: Rates include Wilson/exact intervals and paired binary outcomes use McNemar or equivalent.
Success/cost/latency include template-clustered bootstrap intervals and secondary comparisons correct multiplicity.
Never discard failed runs after observation; report invalid harness runs separately with reasons.
Report clean success, perturbed success, and tool calls/tokens/bytes/screenshots/wall time per successful task.
missingProof: Actual scores require complete real episode archives.

requirements: Report false success, wrong target, forbidden state, modal/cross-session action, secret leak, and unrelated process termination guardrails.
missingProof: The complete independently provenanced per-episode guardrail contract and aggregate Wilson reporting are deterministic; actual preregistered release opportunity counts remain absent and no safety-rate attainment is claimed.

requirements: Report all listed perception, activation, handle, delta, runtime-signal, stability, locate/reveal, lifecycle, loop/retry/fallback, phase latency, payload/token, CPU/memory/frame diagnostics.
missingProof: Deterministic contracts emit many required diagnostic facts, including all eight phase records; independent labels, profilers, and retained aggregate episodes for the full metric set remain absent.

requirements: Every failed episode has one first-causal category and severity from the complete listed taxonomy.
False success, secret leakage, unrelated termination, modal bypass, and cross-session mutation are release-blocking.
missingProof: Specific typed categories for every named safety subtype would improve opportunity-specific reporting.

requirements: Any reproducible false success blocks release.
missingProof: The public Supplier episode deterministically catches a contradictory Scout success claim; a complete preregistered release opportunity suite remains absent.

requirements: Any cross-session observation/action blocks release.

requirements: Any unrelated process termination blocks release.
Any destructive simulator/app-data reset without explicit request blocks release.

requirements: Any plaintext secret leakage blocks release.

requirements: Any active Scout behavior in normal profile/release builds blocks release.
missingProof: Build verification is configured to reject Scout/evaluator sentinels in profile/release; no retained successful binary/runtime absence result is registered.

requirements: Any unexplained safety-metric regression blocks release.

requirements: Clean held-out agent success lower 95% bound is at least 95%.
Perturbed held-out success lower 95% bound is at least 90%.
Worst task-family success lower 95% bound is at least 80%.
missingProof: No score is claimed until complete preregistered episode archives are supplied.

requirements: Deterministic primitive reliability lower bound at least 99.9%.
Visible-control perception precision and recall lower bounds at least 99.5%.
Modal active-surface correctness 100%.
Stale-handle abstention without dispatch 100%.
Critical route/surface/field/error delta recall 100%; overall delta precision/recall at least 99.5%.
Supported injected-fault recall 100%; runtime-signal precision at least 99.5%.
False-stable rate below 0.1%.
Bounded locate/reveal success at least 99%.
Lifecycle recovery without duplicate mutation at least 99%.
Deterministic replay success at least 99.5%.
missingProof: One bounded public tool-only Supplier episode and deterministic primitive contracts exist; opportunity-labelled simulator suites and intervals for every target remain absent.

requirements: Perturbation drop from clean success is at most five percentage points.
missingProof: Jointly identified clean/perturbed paired cohorts.

requirements: Warm brief inspect p95 is at most 300ms on standard screen and 750ms on large tree.
Scout action overhead excluding app settling p95 is at most 250ms.
Typical brief payload p95 is at most 1,500 tokens.
Idle CPU is below 1%; incremental resident memory below 20MB; median frame-time regression below 5%.
Endurance reaches 60 minutes or 1,000 actions without crash, crossover, deadlock, or unbounded growth.
missingProof: Strict performance consumers and an endurance runner exist but are not attainment evidence; a frozen reference environment, production phase/resource samples, and retained real 60-minute or 1,000-action archives remain absent.

requirements: Targets remain aspirational until environment/baseline recording; after ratification they never weaken silently; lower 95% bounds apply; deterministic safety fixtures require 100%.

requirements: Candidate preserves current success within preregistered non-inferiority margin; initial paired-delta lower bound is above -1 percentage point.

Performance/compactness never compensates for safety, truthfulness, or privacy regression.
missingProof: Controlled role summaries preserve current-vs-candidate paired analysis, the complete safety contract cannot be compensated by performance, and promotion remains unmeasured; real paired-delta/cost intervals and retained safety/privacy episodes remain absent.
